title: Reading an audience
steps: In the Google Merchandise Store property, open Admin (the gear icon at the bottom left).
Open the first audience in the list. If its membership duration is not given as a number of days, go back and open the next audience instead.
Note the audience's name exactly as GA4 shows it, its membership duration in days, and its conditions. Viewer access lets you read them but not change them.
When you re-check a week later, choose the audience the same way: the first in the list whose membership duration is given in days.

parts.question: What is the name of the audience you opened? Type it exactly as GA4 shows it.
What is its membership duration, in days?
Read the audience's conditions. Does your screen match the description?
parts.rubric: The audience's details are open. They show at least one condition that says which users are included, built from events, dimensions or metrics, for example users who triggered a given event. An exclude condition may also be shown. The membership duration shown is the number of days you typed.
